title: loranthus brunneus var. butayei
intro: Loranthus brunneus var. butayei, commonly known as the Butayei Loranth, is a species of flowering plant in the family Loranthaceae. It is a hemiparasitic plant that obtains some of its nutritional requirements by connecting to the vascular tissues of nearby host plants. The Butayei Loranth has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as potential applications in the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are thought to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
